directAnswer: To set up a passkey, navigate to your account security settings and follow the prompts to create a new passkey using your device's biometric authentication or a hardware security key.
summary: Setting up a passkey enhances your account security by using a cryptographic method that replaces traditional passwords.

sections.heading: Overview of Passkeys
sections.body: Passkeys are a secure method of authentication that use public key cryptography to eliminate the need for passwords. They can be used across devices and platforms.

sections.heading: Platform-Specific Steps
sections.body: Steps may vary by platform. Below are general instructions for popular operating systems.

sections.heading: Troubleshooting Passkey Setup
sections.body: If you encounter issues, ensure your device supports passkeys and that your software is up to date.

steps.title: For iOS Devices
steps.detail: Go to Settings > Passwords > Add Password > Select 'Use Passkey' and follow the prompts.

steps.title: For Android Devices
steps.detail: Open Settings > Google > Manage your Google Account > Security > Signing in to Google > Add Passkey.

steps.title: For Windows
steps.detail: Open Settings > Accounts > Sign-in options > Windows Hello > Set up a Passkey.

steps.title: For macOS
steps.detail: Go to System Preferences > Users & Groups > Login Options > Set up a Passkey.

faqs.question: What devices support passkeys?
faqs.answer: Most modern smartphones, tablets, and computers support passkeys, but ensure your device's operating system is updated.

faqs.question: Can I use a passkey across different platforms?
faqs.answer: Yes, passkeys can be used across different platforms as long as the services support them.

faqs.question: What if I lose my device with the passkey?
faqs.answer: If you lose your device, you may need to use your backup recovery options to regain access to your accounts.

caveats: Not all websites and services currently support passkeys, so check compatibility before relying on them.
Ensure your device's firmware and software are up to date to avoid issues during setup.
